shared_elements: figures with raised or outstretched limbs
clustering of small motifs into rough horizontal rows or registers
weathered stone as the carrying surface
justification: Both surfaces scatter small isolated motifs — discs, arcs and limbed creature-forms — into loosely horizontal groupings across a stone face, which is the most specific correspondence available. Everything else diverges: A is deep three-dimensional relief carving in a tightly ordered vertical stack of registers with volumetric, recognisable profile animals, while B is thin red linear painting of flat stick-like schemata distributed irregularly over an open rock, with no shared order or hand.
